parsed.post: Discarding the 0.825474 run as it regressed from my best (0.824721). It seems the weight_decay=0.1 probe on depth10 was slightly noisy. I'll stick to the best config (commit 261de19) and instead try reducing the TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144. If small batches helped depth 6/8, they might help depth 10 too.
parsed.description: Reduce TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 524288 to 262144 on the best depth-10 configuration to increase the number of optimizer steps per 5-minute budget.
